finding: Current release is version 1, file 39603295, MD5 026407ff4584cea1ae753fd2cc67156e. Spreadsheet AG15 defines RN time. There are 32 numeric RN times and 128 blank or whitespace entries across 160 lesion rows. No per-lesion reference-standard or explicit event-free field was found in this workbook.
endpoint_action: Keep blanks unknown; do not infer a negative from follow-up dates or death.

finding: The descriptor reports 39 RN lesions, 260 total lesions and 154 distinct segmented lesions. Our release count does not reproduce these lesion totals. Enhancing and necrotic/non-enhancing mask compartments are image tissue compartments, not binary RN-versus-progression diagnoses.
evidence_location: Clinical data and anonymization; Morphological parameters; Subject characteristics
endpoint_action: Record the discrepancy; no extra seven events may be invented or assigned.

finding: The diagnostic study used 109 selected enlarging metastases, including 37 RN and 72 progression lesions. Its methods state that reference labels relied in part on personal communication with the dataset authors.
evidence_location: PDF pages 5-6, Radiation Necrosis Classification; Table 1
endpoint_action: Do not treat an unpublished label crosswalk or a diagnostic selected cohort as a prospectively defined risk cohort.

finding: The study describes 39 MOLAB RN lesions and a separate diagnostic specificity cohort. The inspected public code tree exposes a toolkit and example registry, but no actual lesion-level MOLAB outcome registry was found in that tree at the recorded commit.
evidence_location: Methods 2.1; data availability; chamseddine-lab/rn-d3 tree c4619bab9f27c102a25341ed838dea49fe9ac0c5
endpoint_action: Neither software inference nor the published cohort count can adjudicate this release's blank endpoints.

finding: The study addresses diagnostic differentiation using three post-treatment scans in 175 lesions. Its data availability statement says individual study data are available from the corresponding author by request.
endpoint_action: Do not count this as a fully public downloadable validation cohort. No author contact has been made.

finding: The public calculator estimates RN probability after apparent regrowth on three post-irradiation timepoints.
endpoint_action: Model probabilities must not be used as ground-truth labels.
